title: Client Portal Templates: Examples to Inspire Your Portal Design
summary: Six client portal templates broken down page by page, with the data tables and permissions behind each, so you can start from a proven layout instead of a blank page.
body_markdown:
A client portal template gives you a proven page structure, data model and permission setup to start from, so you spend your time connecting your data rather than designing navigation. Below are six templates, each broken down into the pages it needs, the tables behind it and who can see what. For portals by industry, see our[client portal examples](https://www.jetadmin.io/blog/client-portal-examples/) .


## What every client portal template needs


- **Login and client scoping:** each user belongs to a client account and sees only that account's rows.
- **Home page:** what needs the client's attention right now.
- **Core records:** projects, orders, tickets or cases.
- **Documents:** upload and download, linked to records.
- **Requests:** a form that creates a record and notifies your team.
- **Account settings:** users, roles and billing contacts inside the client account.


## 6 client portal templates


### 1. Project portal


**Pages:** Home (active projects, items awaiting approval), Project detail (milestones, deliverables, files, comments), Approvals, Invoices.
**Tables:** clients, projects, milestones, deliverables, files, invoices.
**Best for:** agencies, consultancies, studios.


### 2. Document collection portal


**Pages:** Checklist (required documents with status), Upload, Signed documents, Messages.
**Tables:** clients, document requests, uploads, engagement periods.
**Best for:** accounting, legal, lending, immigration.


### 3. Support portal


**Pages:** Submit a ticket, My tickets, Ticket detail with replies, Knowledge base links.
**Tables:** clients, users, tickets, ticket comments.
**Best for:** SaaS, IT services, managed service providers.


### 4. Order and reorder portal


**Pages:** Catalog with client-specific prices, Cart and order form, Order history, Shipment tracking, Invoices.
**Tables:** clients, products, price lists, orders, order lines, shipments.
**Best for:** wholesale, distribution, manufacturing.


### 5. Onboarding portal


**Pages:** Welcome and steps, Forms to complete, Documents to upload, Kickoff scheduling, Progress tracker.
**Tables:** clients, onboarding steps, form responses, files.
**Best for:** any service business with a structured onboarding. See our[client onboarding software](https://www.jetadmin.io/blog/best-free-client-onboarding-software-reviewed-ranked/) roundup.


### 6. Billing and account portal


**Pages:** Invoices with status, Payment methods, Subscription and usage, Account users.
**Tables:** clients, invoices, payments, subscriptions, users.
**Best for:** subscription and recurring-service businesses.


## Permissions to set up in any template


Role Can see Can do


Client admin All records for their account, invoices, users Approve, manage users, pay


Client member Records assigned to them Comment, upload, submit requests


Your account manager All records for their clients Update status, upload deliverables


Your admin Everything Configure portal and permissions


Enforce client scoping on the data query, not just by hiding rows in the interface. Otherwise a changed URL or API call can expose another client's data. More on this in our guide to[client portal permissions](https://www.jetadmin.io/blog/client-portal-permissions/) .


## How to customize a template


1. Connect your own data sources instead of the template's sample data.
2. Map your tables to the template's (for example, "accounts" to clients).
3. Remove pages you do not need; clients prefer three useful pages over eight half-empty ones.
4. Add your logo, colors and custom domain.
5. Set up notifications for new requests, uploads and approvals.
6. Test with a pilot client before inviting everyone.

## Frequently asked questions


### What is a client portal template?


A prebuilt starting point for a client portal, with pages, data structure and permissions already set up, that you connect to your own data and customize.


### Which client portal template should I start with?


Pick the one that matches the question clients ask you most: project status, missing documents, ticket updates, order status or invoices.


### Can I use a client portal template with my existing database?


With tools that connect to external data, yes. The template's tables are mapped to yours instead of copying data into the portal.


### How long does it take to launch a portal from a template?


A simple portal can go live in a few days; most of the time goes into mapping data and setting permissions.
